properties.short_description: BuzzFeed is an American internet media company known for news, entertainment, quizzes, and viral content across various lifestyle and pop culture topics.
Getty Images is a global visual content creator and marketplace offering a vast collection of high-quality photos, videos, and editorial images, including sports content.
Just Jared is a multimedia entertainment brand providing celebrity gossip, pop culture news, and entertainment updates through its website and social media platforms.
The New York Times is a leading American newspaper known for its comprehensive news coverage and influential opinion section.
The New Yorker is a magazine known for its unparalleled reporting and commentary on politics, culture, humor, cartoons, fiction, and poetry.
Tinder is the world's most popular dating app, enabling people to meet new friends and romantic partners through swiping.
Omaze is a for-profit entertainment company that offers sweepstakes and prize draws to win luxury experiences and prizes while supporting charitable causes.
VICE is a global media brand known for original journalism and content covering diverse cultural, social, and political topics, including its Spanish-language platform VICE en Español.
HuffPost is a digital media brand known for news, opinion, and lifestyle content across various regions, including British Columbia.
The Onion is a satirical news organization known for its humorous and parody news articles, videos, and digital content.
A museum and research center dedicated to Charles M. Schulz, creator of Peanuts, located in Santa Rosa, California.
New York Magazine is a media brand offering news, culture, entertainment, and lifestyle content through its magazine and digital platforms.
Airbnb is a global online marketplace for vacation rentals and unique travel experiences, offering homes, cabins, beach houses, and more worldwide.
Vulture is an entertainment news brand covering TV, movies, music, books, theater, and art.
The Elton John AIDS Foundation is a philanthropic organization dedicated to ending HIV/AIDS and combating LGBTQ+ stigma through funding, education, prevention, and care worldwide.
An online collaborative media platform founded by Joseph Gordon-Levitt for creative collaboration across various art forms.
Chanel is a luxury fashion brand known for fashion, accessories, fragrance, skincare, makeup, fine jewellery, and watches.
Cameo is a platform that allows users to request personalized video messages from celebrities for various occasions.
Houseparty was a social networking app enabling group video chatting and games integration, popular for connecting friends and family.
Headspace is a digital health brand offering meditation, mindfulness, sleep aids, mental health coaching, and therapy services through an app and online platform.
